contributions.anchor: Box B 'Contributions Received this Period' = $900.00 on the p4 Summary Page, which is also Schedule A's own printed 'Subtotal for this page $ 900.00' and its printed 'Total Contributions Received (Sum of all Schedule A Pages in this report) $ 900.00'
contributions.detail: 3 Schedule A rows on p2: 300.00 + 100.00 + 500.00 = 900.00 EXACTLY, equal to all three printed figures. Box C 'Contributions Received Year to Date' prints $2875.00 and is NOT summed as an increment — it carries this filer's earlier 2022 report, which this period-scoped schedule never itemizes (utah is a per-period regime). The grid holds 15 printed rows of which 12 are empty (crop-proved), so there is no second Schedule A sheet. IN-KIND: this blank HAS a dedicated In-Kind checkbox column and NOT ONE box is ticked; monetary-only and monetary-plus-in-kind therefore give the same 900.00 and both close.

expenditures.anchor: Box D 'Expenditures Made this Period' = $708.33 on the p4 Summary Page, which is also Schedule B's own printed 'Subtotal for this page $ 708.33' and its printed 'Total Expenditures Made $ 708.33'
expenditures.detail: 5 Schedule B rows on p3: 300.00 + 6.43 + 101.90 + 150.00 + 150.00 = 708.33 EXACTLY = the printed page subtotal = the printed total = the promoted per-period Box D. Box E year-to-date prints $2433.76 and is never summed as an increment. The cover ladder is internally consistent on its own terms: F $1149.57 = A $249.57 + B $900.00, and G $441.24 = F - D. (Box A's $249.57 happens to equal the closing balance of this filer's earlier 2022 report, but nothing here was differenced across covers — every figure used to gate a side is printed on THIS document.) No in-kind box is ticked on this schedule either, so both conventions close at 708.33.

itemized.in_kind_convention: MONETARY-ONLY and monetary-plus-in-kind are identical here, and this was tested on the page rather than assumed: the form is the newer 2022 blank whose Schedule A and Schedule B each carry a real IN-KIND CHECKBOX column, and every one of the 30 printed checkboxes across the two grids is EMPTY. The three contribution and five expenditure checkboxes were read from the SAME image as their amounts (§J1's mandated single-block crop, because on this blank the checkboxes print about half a row higher than the amounts they belong to) — no tick exists to misassign. NOTE this filer's OTHER 2022 filing six weeks earlier used the `v. 4.20` blank, which has no in-kind column at all: the convention was re-tested here from scratch and not carried over.
itemized.escalation_note: No cell needed escalation: both schedules are born-digital fillable-form text printed and re-scanned cleanly, and the two block crops rendered every figure and every checkbox unambiguously at 900 dpi. Confidence stays 'medium' because the retained artifact is a page image (SCHEMA §6).

itemized.notes: PAGE-FACE IDENTITY: 'Russ J Rampton' in the Name of Candidate box, on the Affirmation line and on both inner sheets, where index.csv's channel label is 'Russ Rampton' — the page face carries the middle initial and governs. The Office box prints 'Utah County Clerk' here, where this same filer's April report prints only 'County Clerk' — a divergence between his own two filings, recorded and not adjudicated. Report type ticked: '30 Days after withdrawal or elimination' (index.csv's period label is 'Elimination'); amendment answered 'No'; the signature Date and the separate 'Date of Filing' box both read 05/06/2022, as does the 'Date of Report' box on each inner sheet. *** THE SAME FILER USED BOTH 2022 BLANKS, SIX WEEKS APART — the §J1 pattern confirmed on a named filer. *** This report is on the NEWER UNVERSIONED 2022 blank, identified from its own page face: SIX report types (the sixth being 'End-of-Year Report'); SQUARE checkboxes rather than radio circles; the affirmation block correctly headed 'Affirmation' (the v. 4.20 blank mislabels it a second 'Type of Report'); a 'Date of Filing' box and NO Page field, so THE FILING IS UNFOLIATED; schedules with FIVE columns including 'City and State' and an IN-KIND CHECKBOX; the Summary Page's close box LETTERED 'G'; and no 'v.' string in the footer. His 04/04/2022 report (key 60ceafa1) is on the `v. 4.20` blank — four report types fewer, an 'Address and Zip Code' column, no in-kind column, an unlettered close box, and a foliated Page field. Neither filing predicts the other, which is why the form is read off every page of every filing. DOCUMENT SHAPE: 5 pages, all read full-page and each classified from its own printed header — p1 cover, p2 Schedule A, p3 Schedule B, p4 SUMMARY PAGE, p5 the Elections Division CHECKLIST. This filing is NOT a duplex scan (no blank versos), unlike his April report, which is. THE CHECKLIST at p5 is a THIRD revision distinct from the 'HOLD / Staff Signature #1 / #2' form seen elsewhere in this chunk: its top-right box offers only 'Website' and 'Network' with NO 'HOLD' line, and its two review copies are headed plainly 'Staff Signature' with no #1/#2 numbering. Both copies are dated 5/18/2022 (one signed in blue, one initialled in red). This is a data point for the addendum-L4 finding that checklist revision is not a chronological signal: the plain-style revision here carries a MAY 2022 review date, later than both the 3/31-4/6 HOLD-revision reviews and the 4/18-4/20 plain-revision reviews recorded earlier in the wave. The checklist carries no dollar figures and is not a summary page. MASTHEAD: 'Josh Daniels Clerk/Auditor' on all four report pages — NO masthead alternation on this filing, unlike his April report where the two vintages alternate sheet by sheet. REDACTION: the county blacked out the candidate's whole cover address row and his signature; the schedules carry no street addresses at all because the newer blank's third column is 'City and State' by design. His phone and email are published in the clear on the cover and are deliberately not carried into this record. BOTH SIDES CLOSE TO THE CENT on their own printed subtotals, on the sum-of-all-pages totals and on the promoted per-period boxes B and D. FIELD-SHIFT SCREEN passed on both sheets (every cell's content matches its heading). ROW-INDEX TRAPS screened on both: first written entry on band 1 (crop-proved on each), no continuation line, no voided row, no banner line, no doubled band, and nothing below the last entry (crop-proved — neither grid is full, so the control band sits inside the grid and renders empty).
